title: Department to administer [part].
partHeading: PART IV. CHILDREN WITH SPECIAL HEALTH NEEDS
bodyText:
PART IV. CHILDREN WITH SPECIAL HEALTH NEEDS

The department of health is designated as the agency of the State to administer a program of services for children with special health needs.

Note

     §321-51  Department to administer [part].  The department of health is designated as the agency of the State to administer a program of services for children with special health needs.
